kind: frozen-frame pixel identity (Chrome + iOS Simulator) + WebKit Simulator counts (Timeline Paint/Layout records, LayerTree layers/memory) + Chrome idle triple (counts); no timing A/B, no gain claim (timing deferred, user 2026-10-02)

verdict: mechanism (Sim): hero clock backing 1.18 -> 0.39 MB (48 -> 16 backed layers), re-entry clock Paint first 1 s 54-55 -> 23; no idle-paint gain; Chrome style writes/s lower at every spot, LayoutCount/s +1 to +3. Pixels: Chrome identical beyond its A/A; Simulator identical except residual R-fade (delta 1, fade50 mid-roll, 3/26 vs A/A 4/65) -> user decision. Frame gain: not measured (P-072 draft).
